items.title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
items.title_cn: Show-Harness ：只有VLM代理可以玩机器人
items.summary: Foundation vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit broad intelligence about the world, yet translating this intelligence into robot control remains challenging. We present Show-Harness, an Embodied Harness that enables VLMs to "play" robots through a compact semantic interface linking intent to action...
items.summary_cn: 基础视觉语言模型（ VLM ）展示了广泛的世界智能，但将这种智能转化为机器人控制仍然具有挑战性。我们展示了Show-Harness ，这是一种嵌入式线束，使VLM能够通过紧凑的语义界面“玩”机器人，将意图与行动联系起来...

items.summary: Enterprises deploy systems, not checkpoints. Usable capability depends jointly on weights, serving route, precision, output contract, and harness, yet all 18 audited benchmarks score advertised model identifiers.
